description: Unit tests for Azure Storage error handling and validation utilities, focusing on AzureTableUtils and AzureBlobUtils.

classes.name: AzureTableErrorCodeTests
classes.description: Test class containing unit tests for Azure Storage error code and validation functions.

methods.name: AzureTableErrorCode_IsRetriableHttpError
methods.description: Test for identifying retriable HTTP errors based on status code and optional error message.

methods.name: AzureTableErrorCode_IsContentionError
methods.description: Test for identifying contention-related errors based on HTTP status code.

methods.name: AzureTableErrorCode_BadTableName
methods.description: Test that invalid table names throw an ArgumentException.

methods.name: AzureStorageUtils_ContainerName
methods.description: Test that certain container names are invalid and throw exceptions, and valid names pass validation.

methods.name: AzureStorageUtils_BlobName
methods.description: Test that invalid blob names throw exceptions, and certain valid ones pass.

methods.name: AzureStorageUtils_TablePropertyShouldBeSanitized
methods.description: Test that a string with invalid characters is sanitized correctly for table properties.
